note: Audio pipeline v2 (P3b): every text-to-speech engine, model repository and ASR audit tool the dispatch-only audio workflow may install, pinned by version / commit / repository revision. Engines run on the GitHub runner only; nothing here ships in the app (the generated MP3s do). A voice is a candidate until recon downloads its files twice (identical hashes), reads its licence card and applies the licence gate below FAIL-CLOSED; the canary ASR audit then selects the voice cast per course (content/audio/voice-casts.json).

piper.note: Classic MIT engine (the GPL successor piper1-gpl is never used). Voice licences follow each voice's dataset (MODEL_CARD).

kokoro.note: Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0, trained on permissive / non-copyrighted audio per the model card). Non-English G2P is thin (espeak-ng fallback for es/it/pt/fr); VOICES.md grades ja C+ / zh D — the canary audit decides. No Korean, no Vietnamese.

melotts.note: MeloTTS (MIT code, MIT model cards on Hugging Face). The only MIT engine with Japanese and Korean. Chinese is the mixed zh+en model.

whisper.note: Default audit recogniser (Latin-script languages). Never shipped.

sensevoice.modelLicense: other — FunASR MODEL_LICENSE (https://github.com/modelscope/FunASR/blob/main/MODEL_LICENSE); an audit tool that runs on the runner only and never ships
sensevoice.note: Stronger than Whisper base/medium on CJK (plan/06 §3). Used for the audit of zh/ja/ko clips; Whisper remains the fallback (--engine whisper). Not Vietnamese: SenseVoiceSmall knows zh/yue/en/ja/ko and emits Chinese filler for vi (the 2026-10-15 vi canary scored WER 1.0 on every clip for that reason).

licenseGate.note: Fail-closed gate over the licence-relevant lines of each voice's card (dataset licence for Piper voices; model licence for Kokoro / MeloTTS). Allowed for SHIPPED audio: CC0 / public domain, CC BY 4.0, CC BY-SA 4.0 (share-alike accepted — the project publishes derived data under CC BY-SA 4.0 with an in-app attributions screen), Apache-2.0 and MIT (dataset or model). Denied: GPL/AGPL, NC/ND, OpenRAIL / RAIL / Gemma-style use-restricted model terms, CPML, 'Unknown' / 'See URL' (an unverifiable licence is not a redistribution right). A card matching nothing is excluded, never guessed.

loudness.note: EBU R128 two-pass-free loudnorm applied to every clip of pipelineVersion ≥ 2 so engines mix evenly (French clips stay at pipelineVersion 1 — untouched bytes).

encoding.codecNote: codecByLayer is the one codec switch (scripts/lib/audio-codec.ts). story is opus since CI proved Opus playback on device-acceptance API 30 + 34 and the web e2e (PR #51, run 40938703786 + 40938703758, 2026-10-30; release/ASSET_DELIVERY.md). French stays MP3 (mp3OnlyLanguages).
